reviewer_question: Is contestability a new construct or a relabelling of ambiguity and editability?
current_defense: The protocol defines phase-specific observable mechanisms and a cross-stage trace rather than claiming ambiguity itself is new.
evidence_needed: Systematic comparison against ambiguity, contestability, editability, and design-fiction evaluation literature.
response_strategy: Complete comparison set; narrow novelty to the integration and empirical trajectory if required.

reviewer_question: Does BETA simply reveal the seeded answers through semantic labels?
current_defense: Pre-edit responses are collected before controls; pilot includes a cueing failure gate.
evidence_needed: Cognitive pilot; label-neutrality check; possible structure-control condition or claim narrowing.
response_strategy: Treat cueing as part of the affordance or add the approved control; never call it unaided discovery.

reviewer_question: Does the open condition only cause longer answers?
current_defense: Primary outcome is coded from an identical neutral probe; length and dwell time are diagnostics.
evidence_needed: Powered human data and model including prespecified length/time diagnostics.
response_strategy: Withhold interpretive-agency claim if protocol effect disappears under diagnostics.

current_defense: Basic comprehension is a falsification gate and confusion is coded separately.
evidence_needed: Pilot comprehension threshold and formal Study B comprehension results.
response_strategy: Do not use productive-ambiguity language if comprehension materially worsens.

reviewer_question: How can a few discordant cases establish evidence non-substitution?
current_defense: The planned claim is situated and rationale-based, not universal independence.
evidence_needed: Repeated conflicts across briefs/reviewers plus counter-cases and uncertainty.
response_strategy: Report conflict typology and bounds; narrow if discordance is sparse or unstable.

reviewer_question: Can the full two-study design be completed with adequate power before submission?
current_defense: Study A is mechanism-focused; Study B target revised to at least 128 analysable participants with a formative fallback.
evidence_needed: Ethics approval; pilot; recruitment feasibility; frozen clustered power simulation.
response_strategy: Do not submit as a completed empirical full paper unless both human evidence paths are complete.
